summary: Carded from handoff 76629e7f so the work is dispatchable and guard-card permits the edit. Two environment fixes for the dev box CPU floor, neither in app code: Defender exclusions (Antimalware Service Executable measured 11.8 percent, admin shell so Fabio runs it) and VS Code watcher/search excludes for engine, node_modules and .playwright-cli in the gitignored workspace file. Card owns exactly one path: Cubric-Vision.code-workspace.

Baseline captured with the CPU-time delta method: 20 logical cores, 60s window, TOTAL 6.48 percent. Code 2.9 across 19 processes, msedge 1.29, claude 1.01. Antimalware Service Executable did not appear at all, i.e. 0.00 at idle. The box is near-idle right now, so this baseline measures the RESIDENT floor and cannot by itself demonstrate the 42 percent load-time reading.

FIX 2 applied to Cubric-Vision.code-workspace (watcherExclude over engine, node_modules, .playwright-cli, .playwright, logs; searchExclude over the first four). Folders array untouched, still one entry. NOT yet effective - VS Code arms watchers at window open so it needs a reload, which is the user's. Baseline 6.48 percent total on 20 cores over 60s, but the box was near-idle and MsMpEng did not register at ALL, which reframes the problem: both suspects are load-driven, not resident, so an idle re-measure proves nothing and the honest one is during a work burst. Two findings while probing: Defender exclusions cannot even be READ without admin, so FIX 1 is the user's on both halves; and the MCP orphan count has GROWN since the handoff, 4 playwright-mcp plus 14 mcp-official against 4 plus 6, which a window reload also reaps. build/ was considered for exclusion and rejected - it is tracked and holds only two icons.
